title: CreateTicketRequest
description: Consuming site: ticketd/app/server.py:42-49. Body is parsed with get_json(silent=True) -- a non-JSON or missing body becomes {} (server.py:42), not a 4xx.

title.description: Required (non-empty after .strip()). Explicit JSON null is UNEVIDENCED -- see OQ-008; best inference is an unhandled 500, not the 422 path.

priority.description: Accepts int-as-string ("1"/"2"/"3") mapped to low/med/high, OR any other string passed through unchanged, OR omitted (defaults to "med"). server.py:47-49.
